title: New design / train header
slide_intent: Connect a new graphic element to railway activity so the identity feels rooted in its subject.
strategic_value: The familiar DB mark and sleeper rhythm can connect the refreshed identity to rail travel.
demonstration: A red DB mark sits over a blurred train; a growing red sleeper strip runs along the lower edge.
practical_value: Compare the strength of a centered mark with an edge-based secondary element.

content_islands.name: Train and mark
content_islands.spec: Place the red outlined DB mark centrally over the blurred train photograph.

content_islands.name: Sleeper strip
content_islands.spec: Run red vertical bars of increasing width along the bottom edge.

reference_purposes.Expression: The source header combines the DB mark, rail photograph and red sleeper motif.
